title: Liquidation Warning
description: Liquidation ended 17.6% of runs: a red target ring flashes on the ground where it will land, a second before each jump.

title: Fake Breakout
description: A green candle lying on the chart that looks like XP; walk up to it and it flips red and bites, from 4:00.

title: The Miner
description: A third character: a hamster in a hard hat whose drill bores through a line of bears, with less HP but more XP from every candle.
